Functions

.. py:function:: xlsx_to_csvs(filename)

   This function splits an xlsx file into separate CSV files for each sheet.

   :param filename: The path to the xlsx file.
   :type filename: str

   :returns: **folder_name** -- The name of the folder where the CSV files were created.
   :rtype: str
